observations: Three photos show a roadside stall with large stacks of used (tokunbo) tires piled under a corrugated metal roof.
Tires show visible wear, scuffing, and chalk/paint marks (tracking marks from import yards), consistent with used stock.
No visible tire size, DOT code, or brand name legible on any sidewall in the photos.
No single tire is singled out for sale; the photos depict general shop inventory rather than one specific item.
No photo shows tread depth close-up, sidewall cracking, or any size markings clearly.

claims.evidence: No business registration, signage, or distributor credentials visible in any photo; 'Belgium tires' is a trade term for used European-import tires, not a verifiable brand claim from these images.

risks.risk: Actual tire size/diameter unknown, which drives price per tire
risks.proof: Close-up photo of sidewall showing size code (e.g., 205/55R16)
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest common used-tire size bracket seen in comparables

risks.risk: Tread depth and remaining life unknown from a distance
risks.proof: Close-up photo or video of tread groove with a depth gauge or coin

risks.risk: Tire age (manufacture date) unknown, affecting rubber safety regardless of tread
risks.proof: Close-up of DOT date code on sidewall

risks.risk: Hidden plugs, patches, or sidewall damage not visible in group shots
risks.proof: Individual photos of each tire's full circumference and sidewall

proof_requests: Close-up photo of one specific tire's sidewall showing size and DOT date code
Photo of tread depth with a gauge or coin for scale
Full 360° photos of the specific tire(s) being quoted, not the whole stock
response.reason: Photos clearly show generic used (tokunbo) tire stock without any verifiable brand, size, or condition detail, so it is priced at worst case against similarly generic 'Belgium tire' listings rather than graded or verified ones.
